skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, decrease the whole number by 1 and add the denominator to the minuend's numerator, or rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with zero fraction and then borrow as needed.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert improper fraction in mixed number
skills.definition: When a mixed number has an improper fraction part (numerator ≥ denominator), convert it to a proper mixed number by adding the whole number from the fraction to the existing whole part.
